title: Phoebe
description: Phoebe has a refined, eye-catching presence, with her blue tortie ticked and white coat giving her a beautifully soft blend of colour and texture. Her odd eyes make her especially memorable, adding depth and individuality to her calm, observant expression. She carries herself with quiet confidence, balanced by a gentle, composed nature that feels both warm and intelligent. There is a lovely grace to the way she presents, along with a softness that makes her deeply appealing. Phoebe is a truly distinctive girl, full of elegance, character, and natural charm.
